messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] R and Stan code for Gelman and Hill 21.4 and figure 21.7?
parts:
If it's not there, we don't have it.

If you do it and would like to contribute back, we happily
accept code donations :-)

Also, just a warning: none of those models have been debugged,
so some of them might not even compile. They were written rather
quickly. We have on our to-do list a complete rewrite of the BUGS
and Gelman/Hill examples, but never seem to get the time, which
means we still have models with terrible priors we wouldn't recommend
on our public servers.

Do what we say in the manual, not what we do in the examples!

- Bob
